paper_title: A Model-Independent Radio Telescope Dark Matter Search in the L and S Bands
notes: This is a model-independent radio telescope search for ultralight bosonic dark matter decay/annihilation to a quasimonochromatic radio line over 1020-2700 MHz. Limits are reported on the decay constant lambda (~1e-32 s^-1) and velocity-weighted annihilation cross section <sigma v> (~1e-30 cm^3 s^-1), NOT on a standard coupling like g_agamma. The paper explicitly assumes two-photon final states for simplicity but does not convert to g_agamma. The pre-analysis hint of AxionPhoton does not match: the y-axis quantities are decay rate [s^-1] and cross section [cm^3 s^-1], which do not map to any enum coupling type. Local DM density (NFW) ~0.471 GeV/cm^3 (Burkert ~0.487). No extractable (mass_eV, coupling) data points in the required convention. The 3-sigma limits are shown in Figures 8 and 9 but in lifetime/cross-section units. Confidence level is 3-sigma (treated as ~0.99 but recorded 0.90 as closest enum). | read-vote N=3: ct=None (3/3); no consensus curve, took most-points
